description: This file defines the BodySummarizer class in the GuzzleHttp namespace, which implements the BodySummarizerInterface to provide a summarized view of HTTP message bodies. It includes a constructor for setting a truncation limit and a summarize method that returns a truncated or full message body.

classes.name: BodySummarizer
classes.description: A class that provides functionality to generate a summarized version of an HTTP message body, optionally truncated at a specified length.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the BodySummarizer with an optional truncation length parameter.

methods.name: summarize
methods.description: Returns a summary of the provided message, truncated if a limit is set.
